flows.name: Booking Quick-Start

messages.text:
Great choice! Quick question: what brings you to Swing Shack?

1️⃣ Club fitting
2️⃣ Coaching
3️⃣ Practice
4️⃣ Social / group

Smart move. Our fitting assessments start with a R900 Driver Fitting — tells you exactly where your numbers are bleeding yards.

We also do full bag fitting (R1,800), loft & lie (R800), and wedge assessments.

What's your main goal: more distance off the tee, better accuracy, or both?

We have two certified instructors — Catherine and Dave. Coaching starts with a TPI assessment (R1,250) that maps your movement to your swing.

Or if you want to try first: individual lessons from R850. What's your current handicap or level?

TrackMan is available during all practice sessions — you get data on every shot. From R250/hour.

Most regulars grab a Practice Pack (5 sessions for R1,000) — works out to R200/session and keeps you accountable.

Want me to check availability for this week?

Social play is brilliant for groups — TrackMan screens, full bar, and the vibe is unmatched.

4 Players + Beer Bucket: R1,020 for 3 hours. Or if you're just 2 people: R340/hour.

When are you looking to come? I can check what's open.

Sorted! You're booked for [date] at [time]. We'll send a WhatsApp reminder 24h before.

See you then — and welcome to Swing Shack!

flows.why: SA bookings via WhatsApp convert 3x faster than web forms. This flow qualifies intent before booking.

flows.name: Which Service Suits Me?
flows.trigger: Universal — "Not sure which service?" CTA on any page

messages.text:
No stress — let's figure it out together. Quick Q:

Are you looking to improve your game, or are you more about the experience?

1️⃣ Improve my game
2️⃣ Just have fun / social
3️⃣ Both

Cool. Two questions:

1. Do you know what's wrong with your game, or do you just want to get better?
2. Do you have your own clubs?

This helps me figure out if you need fitting, coaching, or both.
quick_replies: Not sure what to work on

messages.text:
Then you want Social Play — full bar, TrackMan screens, group bookings. It's the best indoor golf experience in Johannesburg.

How many in your group? And what day works?

Based on what you've told me, here's what I'd suggest:

[SERVICE RECOMMENDATION — pull from lead profile]

Sound about right? Want me to hold a spot?

flows.why: Captures leads who are browsing but not ready to commit. Qualifies intent, then routes to right service.

flows.name: Pricing FAQ Automation
flows.trigger: "How much does it cost?" message keyword

messages.text:
Here's our pricing at a glance:

🏌️ Practice/Social Play
• Individual session (1h): R250
• 2 Players (1h): R340
• 3-4 Players (3h): R450
• 4 Players + Beer: R1,020

🛠 Club Fitting
• Loft & Lie check: R800
• Single club fitting: R900
• Full bag fitting: R1,800

📚 Coaching (per lesson)
• Catherine or Dave: R850/session
• TPI Assessment: R1,250

Questions about any of these?

flows.why: Removes #1 objection (pricing unknown) instantly. Prevents bounce.

flows.name: Abandoned Booking Recovery

messages.trigger: 2h after booking page exit without submission
messages.text:
Hey [name] — you left the Swing Shack booking page. Everything OK?

Did you get stuck on something, or just not ready to book yet?
No stress — tell me what you're looking for and I'll sort it out right here. Fitting, coaching, or practice?

Totally fair — it's a big decision. One thing I can tell you: our fitting assessment is R900 and most golfers say it's the best R900 they've spent on their game.

No pressure. Just let me know when you're ready — I can check availability in real time.

flows.why: Recovers abandoned bookings. 2h delay avoids being annoying. SA WhatsApp culture accepts this timing.
